name: Peropero ☆ Teacher ~Damedame Onii-chan to Cosplay Ecchi?~
original_name: ぺろぺろ☆てぃーちゃー ～ダメダメお兄ちゃんとコスプレえっち？～
source:
Milky-chan is tasked with caring for her shut-in male friend while his mother is out of town. Feeling she's the only one who really understands him anyway, she accepts the job happily. When he won't come down for lunch, though, she goes up to his room and catches him masturbating to some hentai. Then she finds a book about having sex with women, so she volunteers herself so he can learn and experience the real thing – but it's not complete until she puts on a costume!

(Source: H-Moe)
translation:
牛奶酱的任务是在母亲外出期间照顾她关在家里的男性朋友。无论如何，她觉得自己是唯一真正理解他的人，所以高兴地接受了这份工作。然而，当他不肯下来吃午饭时，她就去他的房间，发现他正在自慰一些色情内容。然后她发现一本关于与女性发生性关系的书，所以她自愿参加，这样他就可以学习和体验真实的事情 - 但直到她穿上服装才算完成！

（来源：H-Moe）
